encounter: E0144 Gerald (Lavaridge Gym room 2) cap36 - attempt 2, rain rebuild
availability_audit: Chronology: every source map precedes the Lavaridge Gym in book play order. Poliwag PetalburgWoods_3 old_rod g20 -> Poliwhirl -> Politoed via trade + King's Rock, pool g30. Lotad Route102 land g14 -> Lombre -> Ludicolo via Water Stone, pool g14. Marill Petalburg City old_rod g14 -> Azumarill g20. Togepi Route102 land g14 -> Togetic friendship -> Shiny Stone Togekiss g24. Swinub Seaspray_Cave_B1F land g14 -> Piloswine -> Mamoswine known-move g36. Squirtle Mauville Game Corner 500 coins g30 -> Wartortle -> Blastoise g36; Blastoisinite stone-window=14, base-window=36. No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species; single Mega slot.
plan: Attempt 1 lost 6-2. The sun is not a flavour detail here - it made a L34 Choice Specs Simisear one-shot a full-HP Thick Fat Mamoswine and let a Chlorophyll Victreebel fire a one-turn Solar Beam that removed Mega Blastoise before it moved twice, while halving every Water move I owned. Rebuild around weather control, which is the documented counter to a manual-sun team. Politoed's Drizzle is up before the first decision, which turns Solar Beam back into a two-turn move, halves the incoming Fire and doubles my own Water. Ludicolo is the key body: Water/Grass resists Fire, Water and Grass simultaneously, so it is the only member that is comfortable whether or not Volbeat wins the weather war, and Swift Swim makes it outrun the Chlorophyll attackers in rain. Priority remains killing Volbeat, because its Prankster Sunny Day can overwrite Drizzle every turn it is alive.
